title: Copy pass over a suffix
statement: Let $r$ be a binary string. For every binary input $x$, prefix $p$, output word $o$, and syntax-scanner state $q$ such that $x=p r$, the dual transducer, started in copying state $q$ at head position $|p|+1$ with output $o$, reaches after exactly $|r|$ steps the copying state carrying the scanner state obtained by processing $r$ from $q$, at position $|x|+1$, with output $o$ followed by the polarity-flipping scan of $r$ from $q$. No configuration before the final step is in the anchor state.
replaced:
Let the input be $x = p \mathbin{+\!\!+} r$, let $q$ be a formula-scanner state, and
let $o$ be an output word. Started in the copying state carrying $q$ at head position
$|p| + 1$ with output $o$, the dual transducer reaches, in exactly $|r|$ steps and
without visiting the anchor state before then, the copying state carrying the fold of
the scanner transition over $r$ from $q$, at position $|x| + 1$, with output $o$
followed by the polarity-flipping scan of $r$ from $q$.
